name: personal-finance
description: Umbrella skill for personal finance queries, reports, and categorization over the shared ~/finances/data.db SQLite store. Auto-discovers <bank>_transactions tables (mono_*, privat_*) via sqlite_master and projects them to a common Transaction shape. Owns pf_* tables (categorization rules, manual overrides). Triggered by report / spending / categorize / find-transaction style questions.
